name: Sasatani
source:
A member of the Regional Adjustment Bureau and a supporting character of the Matchmaker storyline. 

[Based on the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Sasatani]Wiki[/url] description] 

[Spoiler]In reality, he is a spy working for the Okiai Syndicate. He kidnapped [url=/c80801]Shinkai Tsuki[/url] and was "adjusted" by [url=/c80803]Youtaro Oosato[/url].[/spoiler]
